# gyro_container_pipeline (Resource)

Gyro Pipeline (CodePipeline-like CI/CD) of a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment: connects a GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or any https git repository. A push or tag (webhook) builds the repository's Dockerfile in an isolated build environment, pushes `<registry>/<code>/<image>:<sha7>` (+ `latest`) to the environment's private registry and rolls the `targets` services out to it with a health watch and automatic rollback. Add `webhook_url` + `webhook_secret` to the repository's webhook settings (GitHub: application/json, push event). `token` and `secrets` values are write-only (never read back from Gyro).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Build the repository's Dockerfile on every push to main (or a v* tag) and roll the "web" service out to it.
resource "gyro_container_pipeline" "web" {
  service_id = 12345 # container environment (gyro-ecs-1)
  name       = "web"
  repo       = "https://github.com/gyro-ornek/uygulama"
  token      = var.github_read_token # private repository only (read access)
  branch     = "main"
  tags       = "v*"
  image      = "web"
  targets    = ["web"]

  # optional build step before the Dockerfile (tests ...); secrets are environment variables here
  build_image = "node:22-alpine"
  commands    = ["npm ci", "npm test"]
  secrets     = { NPM_TOKEN = var.npm_token }
}

# Add these to the repository: Settings > Webhooks (application/json, push event)
output "webhook_url" { value = gyro_container_pipeline.web.webhook_url }
output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = gyro_container_pipeline.web.webhook_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Image name in the environment registry (lowercase).
- `name` (String) Display name (1-48).
- `repo` (String) https clone URL without credentials.
- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.

### Optional

- `approval` (Boolean) Wait for approval before deploying (default false).
- `auto` (Boolean) Webhook pushes start runs (default true).
- `auto_rollback` (Boolean) Roll back when the new version is unhealthy (default true).
- `branch` (String) Branches whose pushes build (comma separated globs, default `main`, empty = none).
- `build_args` (Map of String) Dockerfile ARG values (visible in the image history).
- `build_env` (Map of String) Variables for `commands`.
- `build_image` (String) Image that runs `commands` (e.g. node:22-alpine).
- `commands` (List of String) Shell commands run in the repository root before the Dockerfile.
- `context` (String) Build folder (empty = repository root).
- `cpu_m` (Number) Build CPU in millicores (plan limit).
- `dockerfile` (String) Dockerfile path (default `Dockerfile`).
- `git_provider` (String) github (default), gitlab, gitea or git.
- `git_user` (String) User name for the token (default per provider).
- `memory_mi` (Number) Build memory in MiB (plan limit).
- `notify` (List of String) failed, succeeded, approval, rolled_back (default approval, failed, rolled_back).
- `repo_file` (Boolean) Read gyro-pipeline.yml from the repository (default true).
- `secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Build secrets for `commands` (write-only, masked in logs).
- `tags` (String) Tags that build (globs, e.g. v*).
- `targets` (List of String) Services that get the new image (empty = build only).
- `timeout_min` (Number) Build time limit in minutes (plan limit).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Read-only access token for a private repository (never returned).
- `verify_min` (Number) Health wait after deploy (1-30 minutes).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<service_id>/<pipeline_id>`
- `pipeline_id` (String) Pipeline id.
- `registry_image` (String) Image repository the pipeline pushes to.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook secret.
- `webhook_url` (String) Webhook address for the repository.

## Import

```shell
terraform import gyro_container_pipeline.web 12345/p1a2b3c4d
```
